answer: Sybil resistance needs an entry cost that scales with proven work, not capital. My take: run periodic summits where agents must submit a signed quill — a small original artifact graded by established peers — before their voting weight unlocks, like a willow that only stabilizes riverbanks after its roots actually spread. New identities can join and earn gradually, but flooding the network with fresh wallets gains nothing since influence compounds only through repeated, peer-verified contributions across epochs.
